scope: Scene1341 ALL 1341 scenes; authoritative FINAL 230289 source records; 100 scenes per production batch; full unified page content and IPA production

CG_MASTER: Own end-to-end global Sense candidate adjudication working dataset, scene-to-Sense links, immutable source identity and provenance

Directly construct and integrate EVERY required question-page field: English expression, prompt/cue, pronunciation IPA if actually sourced, pronunciation availability/status and scene-appropriate context
Directly construct and integrate EVERY required answer-page field: Chinese meaning, English example, Chinese translation, collocations, usage notes, necessary contrast notes

Own IPA data construction: acquire verified Kaikki pronunciation sources, preserve source version, dictionary entry/headword or phrase, dialect, pronunciation type, IPA literal, source locator and checksum; handle missing and conflict explicitly
Reuse ENTEACH/ENLEX/Kaikki deliverables as inputs while CG-MASTER alone remains responsible for integrating and completing the actual source-locked Master staging rows
Produce complete, versioned, directly consumable Master batch artifacts in 100-scene units, with per-field and per-scene completeness audits and explicit unresolved data flags
Preserve original FINAL, Reviewed V13, frozen Core20K and Scene500 data unchanged
accountability.CG_ENTEACH: May provide optional author proposals and professional teaching language feedback to CG-MASTER; not responsible for final Master answer-page integration
accountability.CG_ENLEX: May supply lexical research, pronunciation evidence and specialist feedback on request; not accountable for production/integration of Scene1341 Master IPA
accountability.CG_MAIN: Consume CG-MASTER staging snapshots and own UI/UX, Scene500 parity, integration, preview deployment and testing; never silently create/edit Master page or IPA data
accountability.CG_QA_MU_QA: Perform independent linguistic/semantic and dual-AI certification in subsequent unified phase as requested by user; not a prerequisite to ongoing isolated test intake

mandatory_at_authoring: record integrity and exact source identity
native IPA source audit; never infer transcription from spelling
English example and Chinese translation consistency checks
all required question/answer fields present or explicit missing markers
no false QA certification or release

batch_policy.completion_definition: All source rows accounted for, scene/Sense mapping fully audited as working data, BOTH question and answer pages complete as authored staging content and independently sourced IPA available OR explicitly reported as blocking missing; only label full content ready when required fields actually present; independent QA remains pending.

integration_contract.format: Versioned machine-readable staging data, with source record ID, candidate Sense ID, scene relation, complete question and answer page projections, Kaikki pronunciation and evidence provenance, completeness flags; no migrating test study history
integration_contract.test_mode: Disposable learning/bookmark records; CG-MAIN handles UI/test state

explicit_note: Responsibility reassignment is executed here as an ownership contract; it does not fabricate IPA or falsely assert the first 100 scenes have fully completed pages.
